title: The Rough Escarpment
author: Quentin Ashgrove
blurb: Coral Ashgrove, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
